items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: I was one of the Paul Browns.

ctx.x: That's right. By the way, there's another family of Fosters. Willie Foster, the guitar player, and Pops Foster, George Foster.

Yeah. Any relation? Yeah, well I know. They live in the right union block. There are no relation. No relation. I played with him too. Yeah. Yeah, I played with him on different jobs here. Hops Foster played a few jobs with Emerson. Did you say Buddy Petit lived around here? No, Buddy lived on the water block off of Claiborne, on the, what's that street? That street back there. What is that? Uh, Durbin. Durbin. That's where he lived. Oh, downtown there. Around the Hops. Yeah, yeah. Hops and Hops may be there.…
Did Buddy have a band, Piper's funeral?
